about: Measured trigger-rate runs, newest first. Model matters: Opus and Fable behave very differently, so always record it.

runs.notes: Baseline. Positives 10/31, negatives 7/7, zero mis-routing - every skill that fired was the correct one. Opus reaches for a skill only when a query is unmistakably Kademi-specific.
REJECTED. Edits were tuned against claude-fable-5-1 (train 28/38, val 19/25 there) and do not transfer: no gain on train, four worse on validation. Reverted.

First measurement of kademi-ksync, run against the installed 0.3.0 plugin package rather than the working tree. 7 positives + 1 negative. Negative scored 0.00 and nothing mis-routed - every trigger was kademi-ksync. Three positives scored 0.33, firing once in three: the blocked-sync symptom, the CI/KSYNC_TOKEN query, and - most tellingly - the verbatim 'not a repository branch' error string, which the description does not contain. Hypothesis for a future measured change: the description carries capabilities but not the concrete error vocabulary users paste in. Subset was scored as train with nothing held back, so per CONTRIBUTING it must not be used to select a description change on its own.
